attacks.attack: lost response, ordinary repayment (route record window)
refused: naive rebuild of a landed ordinary repayment is refused
legitimate_path: ordinary repayment lands while its response is lost
the route's next payment lands with a fresh number

sdk_rule.unknown: bit set, no matching event: never rebuilt

refused: sibling attempt of the same repayment from another fee payer is refused
legitimate_path: first signed attempt of a repayment lands

refused: sibling attempt of the same withdrawal from another fee payer is refused
legitimate_path: first signed attempt of a withdrawal lands

attacks.attack: two intents sharing one number (why one allocator per record)
refused: a different intent reusing that number is refused
legitimate_path: first intent under a shared number lands
the second intent lands under its own number

refused: an exact retry under used approval a is refused
a rebuild under used approval a is refused
approval a's attempt cannot run under re-granted approval b
a grant at existing approval number a is refused

legitimate_path: governed payment lands under exact approval a

anyone closes used approval a after its expiry

attacks.attack: settling repayment with appended closes retried after landing

resending only the closes after settlement
legitimate_path: settling repayment lands with its closes appended

attacks.attack: close order: runs, then records, then the Tab
legitimate_path: close_repayment_record before its run is closed is a no-op
close_tab with its run and record open is a no-op
close_run closes the settled run
close_tab still waits for the open record
close_repayment_record closes after its run
close_tab closes once every run and record is closed
